_about: Public-domain Stephen Olin (1797-1851), Methodist preacher, president of Randolph-Macon College and of Wesleyan University, for the Word Hoard: The Works of Stephen Olin (2 vols., 1852: sermons and sketches; lectures and addresses), his 1834 inaugural address and College Life (1867). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 95 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

olin-works-1: The works of Stephen Olin, vol. 1 (New York, Harper & Brothers, 1852)
olin-works-2: The works of Stephen Olin (New York, Harper & Brothers, 1852)
olin-inaugural: Inaugural address delivered by the Rev. Stephen Olin, president of Randolph-Macon College, on the occasion of his induction into office, 5th March, 1834 (Richmond : Printed by Nesbitt & Walker, 1834)
olin-college-life: College life; its theory and practice (New York : Harper & Brothers, Publishers, 1867)

_excluded.olin-other: Travels in Egypt, Arabia Petraea and the Holy Land and Greece and the Golden Horn (travel); his Life and Letters (by others); separate printings of discourses gathered in the Works; 1918 addresses by a later Stephen Olin
